not_covered.text: A Spanish F/A-18 Hornet jet shoots down a Russian drone in Romanian airspace. The drone was downed near the city of Galați after entering from Moldova.
Seven suspected members of the Pakistani Taliban are killed in a intelligence-based joint operation in Kharan District, Balochistan, Pakistan.
Two civilians are killed and several homes are damaged by a government airstrike in Thandwe, Rakhine State, Myanmar.
St. Nicholas' Church from Bączal Dolny is completely destroyed by a fire at the Museum of Folk Architecture, Sanok, Poland.
